description: §38.10.3 clean neg — an `onclient:*` handler declared as a plain `function` compiles with no E-CHANNEL-006; a `server function` named by `onserver:message` stays legal. The delta from `channel/handler-onclient-server-fn` is the `onclient:open` handler's declaration.
rationale: §38.10.3 restricts only `onclient:*` handlers; an `onserver:*` handler runs on the server (§38.6.1).
